description.text: Courses: Chinese for Beginners, Conversational Chinese 301, Intermediate Chinese, Speak Chinese, Intermediate Chinese Listening & Speaking Study Duration: one or half year Starting Time: September of each year Application Date: from April to August of each year; Certificate: Study Certificate

duration.text: The Training Program for HSK at Shandong University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.(Applicants must) Be in good health 2.High school graduate or equivalent or above.
